hebrewText: בְּ/מִסְפַּר֙ כָּל זָכָ֔ר מִ/בֶּן חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה שְׁמֹנַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ

tokens.bdb: a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration
tokens.kjv: [phrase] abundance, account, [idiom] all, [idiom] few, (in-) finite, (certain) number(-ed), tale, telling, [phrase] time.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: properly, remembered, i.e. a male (of man or animals, as being the most noteworthy sex)
tokens.explanation: zakar — macho, masculino, varão, sexo masculino

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: the new moon; by implication, a month
properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.
tokens.kjv: above, exceeding(-ly), forward, on ([idiom] very) high, over, up(-on, -ward), very.

tokens.bdb: a cardinal number, eight (as if a surplus above the 'perfect' seven); also (as ordinal) eighth
hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand
tokens.ptLiteralWord: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet
tokens.enLiteralWord: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet
tokens.explanation: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet
tokens.explanationEn: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet

tokens.bdb: six (as an overplus  beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ord. sixth
a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction
tokens.enLiteralWord: a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction
tokens.explanation: a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction
tokens.explanationEn: a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction

tokens.bdb: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
tokens.kjv: beward, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep(-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch(-man).

tokens.bdb: watch, i.e. the act (custody), or (concretely) the sentry, the post; objectively preservation, or (concretely) safe; figuratively observance, i.e. (abstractly) duty or (objectively) a usage or party
tokens.kjv: charge, keep, or to be kept, office, ordinace, safeguard, ward, watch.

tokens.bdb: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
tokens.kjv: consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, ([idiom] most) holy ([idiom] day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanation: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanationEn: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
